faqs.q: Sec. 86-158. - Disability benefits received from other sources.
faqs.a:
The board shall determine, prior to making any award for disability payments, whether
               the claimant is eligible for workmen's compensation and/or group insurance benefits
               as a result of such disability and shall reduce any such disability benefits to which
               the member is otherwise entitled under this chapter by the amount that the disabled
               member receives from workmen's compensation or group insurance benefits. Group insurance
               benefits as used in this section means group insurance obtained and paid for by the
               city.
(Code 1960, § 19-15; Code 1981, § 26-82)
State Law reference—
Workmen's compensation, C.R.S. § 8-40-101 et seq.
